gizmo.title: Kalenda
gizmo.description: Gosi mmemme dị na faịlụ kalenda dịka kaadị ụbọchị, usoro oge, tebụl ma ọ bụ ndepụta.

configure.title: Faịlụ kalenda
configure.description: Bulite ma ọ bụ họrọ faịlụ kalenda .ics. A na-agụ mmemme ya na ihe nchọgharị.

configure.title: Gosi dịka
configure.description: Otu esi egosipụta ihe dị na faịlụ ahụ.

configure.title: Isiokwu
configure.description: A na-egosi ya n'elu mmemme ndị ahụ, na dịka nkọwa tebụl. Ọ na-abụ aha kalenda ahụ n'onwe ya na ndabara.
